newsitem.title: UK: Associated Nursing account change to hit EPS.
newsitem.headline: Associated Nursing account change to hit EPS.

text.p: Britain's Associated Nursing Services Plc said on Monday it would amend its accounts, hurting the current year's earnings per share after minority interests.
The company said it would amend its accounts for 1995 and 1996 relating to the treatment of several joint venture companies and two sale and leaseback transactions with Nursing Home Properties Plc.
Associated Nursing said the change would have no material impact on its pretax profit for the 1996 accounting period and the current year.
"However, earnings per share after minority interests will be negatively impacted in the current year," the company said in a statement.
The company said it was making the changes to conform with findings by Britain's Financial Reporting Review Panel regarding the application of Financial Reporting Standard (FRS) 5.
"The panel has made it clear that this is its first substantive enquiry into conformity with FRS 5 and that it will also be considering other cases," the company said.
